title: LiquidHR invitations
description: Invite employees securely and track account status separately from onboarding progress.
employmentRequired: No active or future confirmed employment
reviewDescription: Review the recipients. LiquidHR manages the secure activation link and account link.
fixedSecurity: Secure activation instructions are a fixed part of the invitation.

mailPreview.title: Activation email preview
mailPreview.description: Recipients are grouped by their preferred language.
mailPreview.securityNote: The secure activation link and final HTML rendering come from the existing Supabase Auth email template.
mailPreview.editableIntroductionDeferred: An editable introduction is not included: inviteUserByEmail does not safely support per-invitation text. This subpart is intentionally deferred.

nl.subject: Activeer je LiquidHR-account
nl.body:
Hallo {name},

Je bent uitgenodigd voor LiquidHR. Gebruik de beveiligde activatielink in deze e-mail om je account te activeren. De link is persoonlijk en tijdelijk geldig.

Met vriendelijke groet,
LiquidHR

en.subject: Activate your LiquidHR account
en.body:
Hello {name},

You have been invited to LiquidHR. Use the secure activation link in this email to activate your account. The link is personal and expires after a limited time.

Kind regards,
LiquidHR

existingEmpty: There are no invitations in this HR group yet.
loadFailed: The invitations could not be loaded.
